messages:
rachel: kicking off a short 'mini-sprint' this week to prune admin-like roles across staging and prod. primary goals: reduce blast radius, harden audit trails, and validate KMS ACLs.
nikhil: timeline? and are we automating removals or manual tickets?
rachel: plan: 3-day window. Day 1 gather ownermap + recent auths, Day 2 batch non-critical revokes in staging, Day 3 small prod canary. Automation only for low-risk rules (inactive>270d && no deploys). others -> ticket.
tia: how are we defining admin-like? last time the regex matched too broadly and we hit unexpected services.
marc: proposed matcher: /(^|:)admin(\-|\_|$)|engineer:platform:owner|infra:superuser/ and an allowlist for known exceptions. we should also exclude ci/cd robot accounts.
nikhil: KMS: want to avoid breaking key rotation. we should query key usage (Encrypt/Decrypt, Sign) in last 90 days and exclude keys with rotation jobs.
marc: wrote a short query to join key-usage and rotation schedule. ping me if you want the script.
devops-bot: [audit] ownermap snapshot created: s3://redwood-audit/1719345678/ownermap.csv (generated by rachel at 2026-03-21T16:12:58Z)
rachel: good. sec: we need to ensure every revoke has an audit metadata blob: who triggered, reason, pre-state link. add to PR template.
tia: for RBAC changes, can we attach a quick smoke job that exercises login and permission checks? I can add a pipeline that runs authz checks against a small matrix.
nikhil: make sure the pipeline uses read-only tokens. we should avoid re-introducing secrets.
marc: vulnerability note: scanner found a legacy endpoint that accepts role grants via POST /v1/roles/assign without CSRF protection. is that being patched?
rachel: yes, sec team already opened SEC-2420. patch is in review; we should exclude services behind that endpoint from automated sweeps until fixed.
sec-oncall: flagged SEC-2420 as P1 and assigned to infra-api-team.
devops-bot: [jira] SEC-2420 created by marc.
nikhil: about rollback: for each change create a revert PR that re-applies the previous terraform state and includes a short test vector. store state snapshots in s3://redwood-state/entitlement-snapshots/1719345678.tfstate
marc: agree. Also add a short TTL on auto-revocations: if we auto-revoke, create a 'temp-grant' that expires in 30 days so teams can request re-grant via a standard flow.
tia: audit logging retention question: do we preserve raw grant/revoke events for 7 years? compliance asked for 5y.
rachel: we keep a compliance snapshot of entitlements for 7y in cold storage; raw logs retention: 400d for prod, 90d for non-prod. snapshots are exported weekly.
nikhil: smoke plan: after revoke run, wait 15m, run authz-matrix, if >2 services fail in prod -> immediate rollback and page sec-oncall.
marc: can we have a dry-run mode that emits a diff and estimated impacted services count? would be useful for reviewers.
rachel: yes — dry-run will be required for all batches. include impact count and list of affected principals.
devops-bot: [runbook] entitlement-mini-sprint v1.2 pinned: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/entitlement-mini-sprint
sec-oncall: I'll be oncall Friday morning for the prod canary. post exact window in #eng-oncall and tag me.
rachel: noted. final ask: avoid touching HSM-backed KMS keys and any principal linked to cert rotation. we'll maintain an exclusion list in the runbook.
tia: I'll curate the exclusion list and attach it to the ticket.
nikhil: prepping scripts and state snapshot now. will upload to ticket SEC-2431.
marc: splitting principals into batches alpha/beta. alpha = read-only admins; beta = infra engineers; gamma = broad admins (manual tickets).
rachel: excellent. will announce plan and schedule a 30m sync before Day 2. thanks all.
